data.name: Fladder
data.subtitle: Cross-platform Jellyfin frontend
data.localizedDescription: Fladder is a free and open-source Jellyfin frontend built on Flutter, giving you a beautiful Netflix-style interface over your own media library on iPhone and iPad. Direct play and transcode support, offline viewing with sync, multi-server switching, and full library management — no server plugins required.
data.versionDescription: Fladder 0.11.1 | Fladder-iOS-0.11.1 ## What's Changed Release is v0.11.1 is a hot-fix release for v0.11.0 mainly fixing local network connections not working on Android. Besides that the changelog remains the same. ## Music playback Music playback has finally arrived after a long time. The music dashboard can be accessed by long pressing the home button and selecting music dashboard. Including the following features - Music dashboard - Gapless playback - Volume normalization - Fade in/out when pausing and switching tracks that are not in the same album - Lyrics - Syncing of playlist albums tracks etc. The music playback is probably best considered to be in beta. While everything works there can and will be small bugs/annoyances. For AndroidTV navigation of the player controls are a bit cumbersome and will be improved along with other dPad improvements ## Picture-in-Picture ## Filters 2.0 + Library search improvements The filters in the library search view have now been improved. Besides a lot of small bugfixes, more settings are now saved. - Allow setting filters for specific folders inside libraries not just libraries themselves - Add any saved filter to the side navigation bar - Setting a "default/favorite" filter that applies instead of the default behavior for that library. ## Ambient blur For the people that don't like black-bars around their videos there is now the option to enable "ambient blur" this generates a YouTube "theather" like blur around videos. ## ### Exciting New Features 🏕 * feat: Add hotkeys to step through frames by @peanut250 in compatibility.notes: Official release IPA (Fladder-iOS-<version>.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases; the 'nightly' tag is excluded so only stable builds are tracked. Requires a Jellyfin server. A natural alternative to Streamyfin.
